description: มุน 2026-07-29 (calendar Phase 6, FINAL screen): the ปฏิทินดวง notifications list (/v2/calendar/notifications) — the ONLY screen in the set with NO Figma, so it is DESIGNED within DESIGN.md by BORROWING existing primitives (CalendarShell+CalendarMenu, SectionCard group cards, the day-detail #F9F4F0 row style, the DayHeader top-bar, v3 tokens) — no new colour, no bespoke component. goo's useReminders (list=upcoming/past/totalYams/totalDays + cancel) UNCHANGED; the page adds ZERO useState. Two bug-classes the anchor owns: (1) BRAND-DRIFT-WITH-NO-REFERENCE — a no-Figma screen can leave the brand silently (nobody has a frame to catch it); the anchor computed-style-asserts the surfaces map to DESIGN.md tokens (summary bg==v3-sapphire #1455A4, row bg==lemon-chiffon #F9F4F0) and that it borrows SectionCard (not a bespoke component); (2) WRITE-SURFACE cancel — done-condition 2 is 'ยกเลิกแล้วแถวหาย AND ตัวเลขสรุปลดตาม' not just the row → the anchor clicks ยกเลิก through the UI and asserts BOTH the row count (3->2) AND the summary total (list.totalYams 3->2), read on the SAME page at assert-time (บทเรียน P5 near-miss: never navigate away to count, a page that resets per-page state gives a vacuous green — ask where the value lives when you assert). Also proven: real list = goo's 3 mock -> 3 rows (his comment: not a static 1-row picture); the past group 'เตือนไปแล้ว' is faded (opacity<1) AND has NO cancel button (cancel buttons == upcoming count 2, not 3); empty state = แบบ ก (text + ไปที่ปฏิทิน button, no mascot per ฟีม; branch real but forced for the shot since the mock always seeds reminders and past rows are non-cancellable by spec). done-condition proven with goo's shared trackAppFetches (0 app-fetch, no BE). Teeth mut-summary-hardcoded (hardcode the summary number instead of list.totalYams) -> cancel drops the row but the count STAYS 3 -> the count-decrease gate rejects -> CAUGHT. anchor 3a/3b/save re-run green (this page doesn't touch day-detail). screenshot 2 states (list + empty) @393. gate_layer=visual/brand-fidelity+state-write. ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-07 (goo · harness-tidy ใบ ข · on บอง’s ruling): the anchor named here was MOVED to harness/archive/ — nothing runs it (not CI, not an npm script), so the field was advertising a guard that does not run (the shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191). Rule: connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor FILE is kept in harness/archive/ (Rule 1 · Nothing is Deleted); to revive, wire it into CI first, then re-add enforced_by. WAS: harness/run-calendar-notifications.ts#mut-summary-hardcoded
